title: バイオ・化学基礎実験・演習B(応用バイオ)
subtitle: Basic Experiments and Practice in Bioscience and Chemistry B (Applied Bioscience)
educationalGoal: Through experiments and exercises, students will acquire the basic concepts and techniques in conducting biological and chemical experiments using buffer preparation, pH measurement, neutralization titration, and biochemical experiments and exercises with microorganisms
advice: After attending safety training for chemical experiments and microbial experiments, we will start experiments divided into the following three themes: 1. Chemical analysis experiments. 2. Microbial separation experiments. 3. Microbial metabolism experiments. Experiment guidebooks will be distributed for each theme. Students are required to prepare for and complete each experiment.
requiredKnowledge: Be sure to read the keywords in the experiment guidebook and the experiment contents before each experiment. Check the e-syllabus.

activityGoals.body: Ability to explain safe use of laboratory equipment and reagents.
Ability to explain neutralization titration and substance properties.
Ability to explain understand and handle microbial cultures.
Ability to explain create reports based on experimental results.
